Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for Helix Health's clinical notes normalization and triage workflows with a small evaluation (2-week pilot) to measure latency, unit cost, and accuracy on your prompt sets.
- Success criteria (high level): >= 92% slot-matching accuracy on clinical entity normalization test set; median p95 latency < 180ms for 1k request bursts; cost per 1k tokens within the target range we discussed. We'll draft a short success criteria doc for signoff.

Proposed immediate actions: 
1) Technical deep-dive + demo (60m) to show the model variants, quantization options, and outline the trial architecture.
2) Trial kickoff (30–60m) to align owners, share prompt sets, and lock success criteria.
3) Procurement & trial contract paperwork in parallel.

Can you confirm which of these demo windows works for your team (all times PT):
- Tue Apr 6, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Apr 7, 13:00–14:00
- Thu Apr 8, 09:30–10:30

If none work, suggest two slots and we'll adapt. I'll add Marissa (SE) to the deep-dive and Neha (CS) will help with the trial playbook. I'll attach a one-page evaluation charter and a draft success criteria doc for your review.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

—Karthik

Technical deep-dive agenda (detailed):
- Show architecture diagram (service endpoints, VPC option for private trial)
- Walk through model variants (FP16 vs 8-bit quantized) and measured p95/p99 latency at different batch sizes
- Prefix/KV cache demo and how to reduce token cost for repetitive clinical templates
- Live prompt engineering: we'll walk two example prompts (normalization + triage) and iterate on scoring thresholds
- Integration options: REST API, gRPC, SDKs; sample payloads and rate-limit patterns

Pre-kickoff ask (please send before Wed noon PT):
- Representative prompt set (<=200 prompts) with expected outputs or labels
- Target throughput (requests/sec) and acceptable latency thresholds
- Any redlines your security team requires for the trial (we'll honor minimal data retention and can enable encrypted logs)

Attachments: redwood_trial_playbook.pdf (trial runbook), SOC2-summary.pdf (one-pager)

I'll bring a short demo workbook and the prompt template. See you Wed at 13:00 PT.
